messages:
deploy-bot: started canary v2026.03.22-rc7 -> 10% at 14:02Z. preflight OK. audit=a-1748888888

erin: watching SLO dashboard — embeddings p95 (ap-south) jumped 4x immediately after shift, small 5xx rise 0.9%. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/d/embeds/1748888888

josh: logs show repeated "kv_write_timeout" on embed-worker-7 and a handful of "oom_protect" traces. snippet: ```2026-03-22T14:03:11Z embed-worker-7 ERROR kv_write_timeout shard=21```

priya: telemetry-bot, did any autoscaler actions fire?

telemetry-bot: Autoscaler: no scale events in the last 5m. Noted spike in queue_latency on embed-router-2.

ops-bot: Canary control: AUTO-HOLD triggered by rule slo.p95.delta > 3x AND error_rate > 0.75% -> state=PAUSED at 10%.

erin: ok hold. three mitigation options: 1) safe-pin embeddings route to stable model:v2.3.0 2) staged rollback for region ap-south only 3) immediate full rollback. prefer staged rollback to reduce blast radius. thoughts?

josh: prefer staged regional rollback for ap-south. kernel mismatches in recent build might be causing memory pressure on some workers. pin won't fix oom_protect.

priya: +1 staged rollback. I'll prepare the rollback patch and update release-notes. also will kick off a small warmup on other shards to test behavior. command: `scripts/soak.sh --route embeddings --region ap-south --qps 50 --dur 45s`

erin: josh, can you run a quick heap-check on embed-worker-7 and confirm whether it's per-process or system-level?

josh: running `ssh embed-worker-7 sudo heapdump --since 14:00` now. returning small heap growth, looks per-process. attaching trace to INF-4200.

priya: executing regional rollback now: `PATCH /routing/embeddings?region=ap-south {"version":"v2026.03.01","reason":"canary pause - ap-south p95/5xx spike"}`

deploy-bot: routing change applied by priya at 14:06:52Z -> embeddings (ap-south) -> v2026.03.01. audit=a-1748888888

josh: post-rollback metrics: p95 in ap-south back to 115ms, 5xx 0.12%. memory pressure reduced on embed-worker-7. kernel warnings ceased.

erin: ops-bot, keep canary paused. we'll hold global resume until we get 20m of stable telemetry in all regions. create postmortem: INF-4200.

ops-bot: Canary remains PAUSED. Manual resume required.

priya: release-notes updated: "v2026.03.22-rc7 canary paused: ap-south partial rollback due to worker kv_write_timeout and elevated p95. Postmortem INF-4200. Pinning avoided due to memory signals." cc @support @ps

erin: assign ENG-RUNTIME + ENG-ML to INF-4200. prioritize kernel packaging and runtime memory regression.

josh: leaving routing note: "regional rollback applied during canary for ap-south; investigate memory regression and kernel packaging for rc7"

telemetry-bot: Monitoring watch created: watch-INF-4200 -> alerts forwarded to #oncall if p95 > 2x baseline OR 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.

erin: good triage. we'll reconvene in INF-4200 after logs and heap dumps. closing this thread for now. :white_check_mark:
